rows.name: Tadeusz Mazowiecki
rows.office: Prime Minister (Chairman of the Council of Ministers)
rows.note: rulers.org: '24 Aug 1989 - 4 Jan 1991 Tadeusz Mazowiecki (b. 1927 - d. 2013)'; full birth date 18 April 1927 from the Wikipedia infobox. Head of government in a parliamentary system, so he and not the president directs the executive. Jaruzelski's PZPR is not in the party table (it dissolved itself on 29 January 1990), hence party null.

rows.name: Benazir Bhutto
rows.note: rulers.org: '2 Dec 1988 - 6 Aug 1990 Benazir Bhutto (f) (1st time) (b. 1953 - d. 2007)'; full birth date 21 June 1953 from the Wikipedia infobox. The president who dismissed her that August is in 'also' as a fact of 1 January 1990, not as a forecast.

rows.name: Chatichai Choonhavan
rows.note: rulers.org: '4 Aug 1988 - 23 Feb 1991 Chatichai Choonhavan (b. 1922 - d. 1998)'; the Wikipedia infobox gives 5 April 1920 and names his party as Thai Nation (Chart Thai). The two sources disagree on the birth year; the full date is entered and the disagreement recorded here rather than resolved.
